title: Claude: Bird is in the connector directory
summary: Bird is now one click away in Claude. Add it from the connector directory and ask Claude to handle your email, SMS, WhatsApp and inbox.
body_markdown:
Bird is now one click away in Claude. Add it from[Claude's connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/bird) , connect your workspace, and ask Claude to handle your email, SMS, WhatsApp and inbox:


- "Set up acme.com as a sending domain and tell me which DNS records to add."
- "How did last week's newsletter do?"
- "Why are emails to Outlook bouncing?"
- "Draft replies to everything unanswered in my support inbox."
- "Create an inbox for yourself on inbox.ai and check what has arrived."
